subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Numbers turned complaints into evidence.”?
options: Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
The lunch bell returned the next day, but a few students started wearing watches.
It simply took one article for students to see work that was usually invisible.
The sun was the same, but the surfaces below it changed how much students suffered.
